Name: Minakie's Recipes
Author: Minakie
TagLine: A mod that adds new foods and recipes to the game, sold by Gus at The Stardrop Saloon.
Description:
<s>![](https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png) </s>This mod adds new foods and recipes to the game, that you can buy from Gus, at The Stardrop Saloon.

**_Full List of Recipes_** (alphabetical order):

 - breakfast cereals
- bunny biscuit
- chocolate bunny
- chocolate cereals
- chocolate cookies
- chocolate egg
- chocolate fish
- chocolate heart
- chocolate milk
- chocolate muffin
- chocolate pizza
- chocolate refreshment
- chocolate soup
- chocolate star
- chocolate stick
- fish biscuit
- lemonade
- lion cupcake
- Nutella
- oatmeal
- star biscuit

![](https://i.postimg.cc/SKDkt5hJ/update.png)

- As of version 1.0.1, all items are being translated by me into Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese (there may be some errors in the use of some prepositions). Translations into Chinese are being done by [asqwedcxz741](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76474198), so those may always be released a bit after any mod updates.

- The initial version was released only with Chocolate Milk. Version 1.0.2 adds 20 new foods, all with custom recipes. Some of those recipes require ingredients added to the game by other mods, so make sure to install [Artisan Valley](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926), [Drink More Water](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4384), [More Recipes](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1670), [More Trees](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671), as well for my foods to work properly.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/SxLycR1L/credits.png)

- Roku for requesting Chocolate Milk in #modding
- [asqwedcxz741](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76474198) for the Chinese translations :)
